proof.source: Allikvere arxiv2609.02604v2 section4.3 Lemma4.3, known union-bound reasoning, not novelty
proof.claim: For a checked prefix, let U be all folded grid times good for assigned coordinates. For each remaining coordinate i, independently reconstruct b_i=max over ALL legal digits d of |U intersect B_i,d|. If |U|>sum b_i, then for every completion its chosen bad-set union covers at most sum b_i times, leaving a time good for every coordinate. This is forall completion exists witness, not one common witness.
proof.folding: j=0 fails positive threshold; j and M-j have identical distances. Exact j=1..floor(M/2) masks preserve existence, including equality and midpoint.
proof.prefixInvariant: Consumer derives its own BigInt good masks; root U is exact folded grid. Exact legal child-prefix validation precedes independent intersection with that coordinate/digit good mask, so child U is exactly the times good for all assigned coordinates by induction.
proof.counts: Exact decimal BigInt cardinality of each leaf is product of lengths of all unassigned original scope axes. Checked exhaustive ordered partitions imply disjoint total coverage. No Cartesian tuple enumeration occurs in production cover-bound verification.
proof.gcd: Only fully assigned empty-U leaves may use exact gcd(targetLevel,all other residues)>1. Lower LRC12 remains explicitly declared and unreplayed. SURVIVOR likewise requires singleton empty U and all13 omit-coordinate gcds equal1; no continuous-time exclusion is claimed.
